currency_note: All prices in USD unless an entry has a "currency" field; those are converted to USD on load using data/fx.json.

entries.label: Budget LLM API (Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite)
entries.notes: Paid tier, standard (non-batch) text pricing. Batch API: $0.05 in / $0.20 out. Context caching: $0.01 per 1M cached input tokens (implicit caching is on by default for Gemini 2.5; minimum 2,048 input tokens per request, stated for Flash and Pro and assumed for Flash-Lite). Explicit caches also pay storage per hour, not modelled.

entries.label: Mid-tier LLM API (Gemini 2.5 Flash)
entries.notes: Paid tier, standard (non-batch) text pricing. Batch API: $0.15 in / $1.25 out. Context caching: $0.03 per 1M cached input tokens (implicit caching is on by default for Gemini 2.5; minimum 2,048 input tokens per request, stated for Flash and Pro and assumed for Flash-Lite). Explicit caches also pay storage per hour, not modelled.

entries.label: Premium LLM API (Gemini 2.5 Pro)
entries.notes: Paid tier, prompts <= 200k tokens. Batch API: $0.625 in / $5.00 out. Context caching: $0.125 per 1M cached input tokens (implicit caching is on by default for Gemini 2.5; minimum 2,048 input tokens per request, stated for Flash and Pro and assumed for Flash-Lite). Explicit caches also pay storage per hour, not modelled.
